nodes.t: Captain. Big fan. Well, small fan. She'll get bored of you by Diwali. She gets bored of everyone.

nodes.n: Splash. Nine hundred guests film it. By morning, "Captain Yorker" is the number one trend. Nikhil is furious. Tara laughs for a full minute.
Mumbai. Her sea-facing flat. Twenty-second floor. The rules are taped to the fridge in her handwriting.
"1. Your room is the small one. 2. No cricket on the big TV. 3. Don't touch Simba." Simba is a cat. Simba hates you.

nodes.t: So. Married life. Do you cook? Please say you cook.

choice.t: Make her aloo parathas, Dadi's recipe.
Order in from her favourite place.
"I'm a cricketer. I eat boiled chicken."

nodes.t: ...These are better than my chef's. Don't tell my chef. Don't tell anyone.

nodes.n: 2 AM. You hear her in the kitchen. She's on the phone, whispering.

nodes.t: Maa, please. I can't send more. The film didn't... I know. I know. I'm sorry.

nodes.n: In the morning, a photo is on every gossip site. Taken with a long lens from the next building. Two bedroom lights. Two separate windows.

nodes.cliff: One photo. Two bedrooms. And the whole country asking a question you can't answer.
